label: Pure act
resolution: Pure act in the sense of DEF-PURE-ACT means being in potency in no respect. Strict pure actuality (DEF-STRICT-PURE-ACTUALITY) means that every real determination of the being is a pure perfection, so it has no real individuating, receiving or limiting principle that is not an actuality. The first does not imply the second: a real thisness that is neither a potency nor a perfection satisfies the first and violates the second (withoutStrictPurity). The pure-act thisness results use only the strict sense, as an explicit open premise; no step derives it from the absence of potency.
